checking.long: Checking the connection to the server…

online.long: The server is responding. This is a basic check: the state of the transcription engines is in Settings.

offline.long: The server can't be reached. You can keep recording and saving; send it for transcription when it's back.

limited.long: The server asked to slow down after too many requests. The app pauses on its own and carries on as soon as it can; you don't need to do anything.

studio.lede: Record a meeting right here, or upload an audio or video file. We transcribe it and leave it ready to read, analyse and download.
studio.offline: No connection to the server. You can record and save; transcription will be sent when it's back.
studio.recentEmpty: Your latest recordings and files will show up here.

recorder.title: Recorder
recorder.hintMic: Press Record to start. If you close the tab by accident, the recording is recovered when you come back.
recorder.recovered: An interrupted recording was recovered. You'll find it in the library.

errors.unsupported: This browser can't record audio, or the page wasn't opened over HTTPS (localhost works for local development).
errors.denied: Microphone permission was denied. Enable it from the padlock in the address bar and try again.
errors.noDevice: No microphone found. Plug one in and try again.
errors.busy: The microphone is being used by another application.

review.title: New recording
review.name: Name
review.transcribeNow: Transcribe as soon as it's saved
review.heading: Listen and save it

dropzone.title: Drop your audio and video here
dropzone.hint: They're kept in this browser and sent for transcription. Up to 2 GB per file.

card.failedNote: Transcription failed. You can try again.
card.remoteNote: Opened by identifier: the audio isn't in this browser.

empty.title: It all starts with a voice
empty.text: There's nothing here yet. Record your first meeting or upload an audio or video file.

byId.label: Meeting identifier on the server
byId.invalid: That doesn't look like a valid identifier (GUID).
byId.note: The server doesn't list meetings, so the library is kept in this browser. Here you can bring in a meeting from another browser if you know its identifier. It won't have the original audio.

meeting.notFound: We can't find that meeting in this browser
meeting.uploadingHint: Don't close this tab until the upload finishes.
meeting.processingHint: You can close the tab or keep using the app: you'll see the result when you're back.
meeting.failedHint: Retrying processes the whole audio again from the start and uses the server's machine again.
meeting.uploadFailedText: The file is still saved in this browser. Check your connection and try again.
meeting.localText: The audio is safe in this browser. Pick the language and send it whenever you like.

transcript.chunkTiming: With this model the timestamps are approximate: each block marks the start of a chunk of about 10 minutes, not of each sentence.
transcript.speakerScope: Voice labels (A, B…) restart in every chunk of about 10 minutes: “Voice A · part 1” and “Voice A · part 2” may be different people. Name them by hand to unify them.

speaker.detectedHint: Name detected because they introduced themselves in the meeting. You can change it.

analysis.disclaimer: Automatic reading done in your browser with counts and text patterns, no AI. It can be wrong or miss things: always check it against the audio, especially names, figures and dates.
analysis.disclaimerShort: Detected by text patterns, no AI. Verify it against the audio.
analysis.shareByWords: This model gives no per-sentence timing, so the split is by word count, not by speaking time.
analysis.actionsHint: Sentences that usually introduce a commitment or something pending.
analysis.actionsEmpty: No commitments were detected with the usual phrasing.
analysis.figuresHint: Amounts, percentages and dates: the costliest things to get wrong.
analysis.figuresEmpty: No amounts or dates were detected.
analysis.questionsEmpty: There are no questions in the transcript.

export.title: Download transcript
export.txtHint: With time and name for each voice
export.mediaHint: The file saved in this browser

settings.audioLanguageHint: Sent to the server with every file.
settings.autoTranscribeHint: Automatically sends each new recording or file to the server.
settings.connectionHelp: The app talks to the API through a proxy (/api) that adds the access key, so the key never reaches the browser.
settings.privacy: The folder you choose is the final destination of every meeting. This browser also keeps a working copy so you can listen to and read them in the app, and the server keeps a temporary copy (24 h) while it processes. Clearing local data doesn't touch your folder or the server copy.

errors.offline: The server can't be reached. Check your connection.
errors.auth: The server doesn't accept the access key. Check BACKEND_API_KEY in the .env file.
errors.notFound: The server doesn't know that meeting.
errors.conflict: The meeting isn't in a state that allows that action.
errors.tooLarge: The file exceeds the size the server accepts.
errors.unsupported: The server doesn't accept this kind of upload.
errors.server: The server had a problem. Try again in a moment.
errors.mediaMissing: The file is no longer stored in this browser.
errors.storage: Couldn't save to the browser's storage. It may be full or blocked.

job.ProcessingFailed: The server couldn't process the audio.
job.WorkerInterrupted: The server was interrupted while working on this meeting.
job.unknown: The server didn't give a reason.

errors.forbidden: The server doesn't allow this action.
errors.blocked: The server has temporarily blocked this machine's requests after too many attempts.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests in a row.
errors.paused: Paused because of the server's limits.
errors.unavailable: The server can't handle this right now.

codes.ProcessingFailed: The server couldn't process the audio.
codes.WorkerInterrupted: The server was interrupted while working on this meeting.
codes.WorkerPersistenceFailed: The server couldn't save the transcription progress.
codes.UnexpectedError: The server hit an unexpected error.
codes.MediaProcessingTimeout: Preparing the audio took too long on the server.
codes.InvalidMediaOrMissingAudio: The file is damaged, its format isn't supported, or the video has no audio track.
codes.NoAudio: No speech was found in the audio to transcribe.
codes.ChunkTooLarge: A chunk of the audio was too large to process.
codes.FFmpegUnavailable: The server can't find FFmpeg, which it needs to prepare the audio.
codes.WhisperModelMissing: The transcription model (Whisper) is missing on the server.
codes.WhisperRuntimeUnavailable: The transcription engine (Whisper) can't start on the server.
codes.WhisperInferenceFailed: The transcription engine failed. The model may be damaged or the machine may be short of resources.
codes.DiarizationRuntimeUnavailable: The speaker separator isn't installed on the server.
codes.DiarizationModelMissing: The speaker separation model is missing on the server.
codes.LocalInferenceTimeout: The server machine took too long to process. Try again with less load.
codes.LocalInferenceBusy: The server is already generating another summary. Wait for it to finish and try again.
codes.SummaryUnavailable: The local summarizer (Ollama) isn't running on the server.
codes.SummaryModelMissing: The summary model hasn't been downloaded in Ollama.
codes.SummaryModelNotLocal: The configured summary model isn't local, so the server won't use it.
codes.SummaryInvalidResponse: The model returned an invalid summary. Try again.
codes.SummaryInputTooLarge: The transcript is too long to summarize.
codes.MeetingRetryLimitExceeded: This meeting has reached the maximum number of retries.
codes.MeetingNotFailedOrRetryLimitExceeded: The meeting can't be retried: it hasn't failed or there are no retries left.
codes.MeetingStillActive: The meeting is still being processed; wait for it to finish.
codes.LocalFilesNotSaved: The files have to be saved first.
codes.SecurityCapacityReached: The server is overloaded right now. Try again in a few minutes.
codes.ProviderQuotaExceeded: Failed due to the old external provider quota. It is no longer used: retry with the local engines.
codes.ProviderSpendLimitExceeded: Failed due to the old external provider spend limit. It is no longer used: retry with the local engines.
codes.ProviderRateLimited: The old external provider rate-limited the requests. It is no longer used: retry with the local engines.
codes.MissingProviderKey: The old external provider key was missing. It is no longer used: retry with the local engines.
codes.MeetingNotFound: The server no longer has this meeting.
codes.RecordingNotFound: The server no longer has this meeting's original file.
codes.ResourceNotFound: The server can't find what was requested.
codes.InvalidRequest: The server rejected the request as invalid.
codes.RequestValidationFailed: The server rejected the data sent.
codes.UnsupportedMediaType: The server doesn't accept this kind of upload.
codes.UploadTooLarge: The file exceeds the size the server accepts.
codes.UnsupportedMediaFormat: The server doesn't support this file format.
codes.FileNameTooLong: The file name is too long.
codes.InvalidLanguage: The language is not valid (it must be a two-letter code, such as es or en).
codes.AuthenticationRequired: The server doesn't accept the access key.
codes.AccessDenied: The server doesn't allow this action.
codes.GlobalRequestLimited: The server is receiving too many requests right now.
codes.ServerConcurrencyLimited: The server is busy with other requests.
codes.RequestBurstLimited: Too many requests in a row.
codes.RequestConcurrencyLimited: Too many requests open with the server at once.
codes.RequestRateLimited: Too many requests in a short time.
codes.ClientTemporarilyBlocked: The server has temporarily blocked this machine's requests.
codes.HttpMethodNotAllowed: The server doesn't allow this operation.
codes.HttpsRequired: The server requires a secure connection (HTTPS).

local.askTitle: Where do you want to keep your meetings?
local.askText: Pick a folder on your computer: the recording, transcript and summary of every meeting will end up there. The server only keeps a temporary copy while it processes, and your folder's path never leaves the browser.
local.needsPermission: The browser needs you to authorise writing to “{name}” again.
local.denied: Access to “{name}” was denied. Pick the folder again.
local.unsupported: This browser can't pick a folder (Chrome or Edge over HTTPS or localhost is required). You'll be able to download each meeting's files instead.
local.autoSaveHint: As soon as transcription ends, the files are written to the folder. Deleting the server copy is always a manual step.
local.expired: The server's temporary copy has expired: the server may have deleted it already.
local.serverDeleted: The server copy has been deleted. What remains is in your folder.
local.step1Hint: Original, transcript (JSON and TXT) and, if you already generated it, the summary.
local.step2Hint: Generate it in the Analysis tab before saving and it will be included in the folder.
local.step3Hint: Permanently deletes the original and the transcript from the server. Your files are untouched. It doesn't remove the server's backups.
local.deleteLocked: Unlocks once the files are saved.

errors.unsupported: This browser can't write to a folder.
errors.permission: Permission to write to the folder is missing. Renew it and save again.
errors.inactive: The meeting isn't ready to be saved (or its transcript isn't in this browser).
errors.disk: There is not enough disk space.
errors.verify: A file wasn't written completely. The server copy is intact: try again.
errors.expired: The server no longer has the files (the temporary copy expired or was deleted).
errors.artifact: The server refused a file download (HTTP {status}).

summary.title: Summary
summary.cost: Generated by the server with a local model, no external services. It takes a few minutes and runs one at a time. It is kept in this browser and included when saving to the folder.
summary.draftNotice: Automatically generated draft. Requires human review.
summary.unavailable: The server copy was deleted: a new summary can no longer be generated.
summary.evidenceNote: The numbers link to the sentence in the transcript that supports each point. A valid reference does not certify that the content is true.

errors.tooLong: The transcript exceeds the 500,000-character limit for summaries.
errors.invalid: The model returned an invalid summary. Try again.
errors.unavailable: The server's local summarizer isn't available right now.
errors.timeout: The local model took too long. Try again with less load on the server.

mic.label: Microphone
mic.missingNote: The microphone you chose is no longer connected. The system default will be used when recording.
mic.grantHint: The browser only shows microphone names once you give it permission. This step doesn't record anything.
mic.denied: Microphone access is blocked. Enable it from the padlock in the address bar and reload the page.
mic.unsupported: This browser can't choose the microphone.
mic.fallback: The chosen microphone wasn't available: the system default was used for this recording.

engine.title: Server engines
engine.notReady: The server can't transcribe right now.
engine.help: Everything runs on the server with local models: Whisper to transcribe, Community-1 to separate speakers and Ollama to summarize. Being ready doesn't guarantee every transcription will come out right.

detail.queued: Waiting for its turn on the server
detail.diarizing: Analysing the voices across the whole meeting
detail.naming: Looking for introductions ("my name is…") to name the voices
detail.Queued: Waiting for its turn on the server
detail.Processing: The server restarted and is resuming the job
detail.DetectingSpeakers: Analysing the voices across the whole meeting
detail.IdentifyingSpeakers: Looking for introductions ("my name is…") to name the voices

live.etaUnderMinute: Less than a minute of transcription left
live.channelLiveHint: The server sends progress as it happens.
live.channelPollHint: The status is checked every few seconds (the server allows 2 live trackers at once, or the connection was lost).
live.speakersPending: They will show up as soon as the server finishes separating the voices.
live.introducedHint: The name comes from an introduction in the meeting itself ("my name is…"). Check it in the transcript.
live.speakersNote: Names only appear if the person clearly introduced themselves. You can name them yourself afterwards.
